audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 2 and 4 were Ziggs at 8/10 and rows 3 and 5 were 'Skill', the opposite of what the already-audited mirror settled.
audit.why: audits/top/yorick__ziggs.json set rows 2 and 4 to Skill at 5/10 and rows 3 and 5 to Ziggs at 3/10 on his page. Level 3 is when Mourning Mist comes online and level 6 is the Maiden, so those are the even stages; 4-5 and the first-item row are yours.
audit.corrected: Row 2 to Skill (5/10), row 3 to Ziggs (7/10), row 4 to Skill (5/10), row 5 to Ziggs (7/10), as matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 row said the Maiden is 'not a duel threat', which is true but skips what she actually costs you, and gave no cooldown.
audit.why: Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100s at 600 range: the Maiden makes Yorick's attacks on her target hit harder and raises Walkers from dead enemies on her own, so the level 6 problem is a permanent siege body in the sidelane, not a duel.
audit.corrected: whys[4] and spikes[1].text rewritten around the 160s and what the Maiden does.

audit.whatIsWrong: Slots are wrong in two places and the ghoul source is wrong in a third: spikes[1] calls the cage 'Dark Procession (E)' when it is his W, and spikes[0] calls Mist Walkers 'W-summoned ghouls' when W is the cage.
audit.why: Riot kit: Dark Procession (W) is a destructible wall, 20/18/16/14/12s at 600 range; Mourning Mist (E) is a 700-range globule on 12/11/10/9/8s that reduces armour, slows, marks you and speeds his summons toward the mark; the Walkers come from graves dug by Last Rites (Q) and by the Maiden. Last Rites is also an auto-attack reset that heals him — the wind-up is the tell, and Grievous Wounds is what beats it.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text and spikes[1].text rewritten with correct slots, the grave mechanic, the two cooldowns and Grievous Wounds; dontsFull[0].d now states the Last Rites reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, and dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Dark Procession is 20s at rank 1, not 15 — that is the actual step-up window after he wastes the cage.

edits.before: Level 3 your AoE erases his Mist Walker stacks before they threaten you.
edits.after: Level 3 Mourning Mist (700 range) cuts armour and speeds his ghouls.

edits.before: Level 6 stays with you — his Maiden is a splitpush tool, not a duel threat to a ranged mage.
edits.after: At 6 the Maiden (160s at rank 1) raises Walkers from your dead minions and sieges.

edits.before: Yorick's whole game is his Mist Walkers (W-summoned ghouls). Use Short Fuse autos and a bounced Bouncing Bomb to clear ghouls the moment they spawn so they never stack onto you, and poke Yorick himself while he's tied to CSing. Drop Hexplosive Minefield behind the wave to punish his walk-up.
edits.after: Yorick's Mist Walkers rise from the graves Last Rites (Q) digs, so clear ghouls with Short Fuse autos and a bounced Bouncing Bomb the moment they spawn, and poke Yorick while he is tied to CSing. Drop Hexplosive Minefield behind the wave to punish his walk-up, and buy Grievous Wounds — Last Rites heals him.

edits.before: His Maiden of the Mist (R) is the spike, but she's a splitpush tool, not a duel threat against a ranged mage. Clear the Maiden and ghouls with your AoE, keep poking Yorick, and don't get cornered by his Dark Procession (E) wall — save Satchel Charge to blast out of the cage.
edits.after: Maiden of the Mist (160s at rank 1) is his spike, but she is a siege tool, not a duel threat to a ranged mage. Clear her and the ghouls with your AoE, keep poking Yorick, and never let him corner you with Dark Procession (W, 20s at rank 1) — save Satchel to blast out of the cage.

edits.before: Yorick burns Dark Procession (Cage) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Dark Procession is down 20s at rank 1 — a wasted cage is your window to step up.

edits.before: That’s Yorick’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
